arguments.summary:
Fixed two issues in src/aeread/housing_env.py:
1. Tie-breaking logic: Changed sorting key from (type(value).__name__, repr(value)) to (type(value).__name__, value) to sort tenant IDs numerically instead of lexicographically, ensuring lower numeric IDs win ties.
2. Overflow error handling: Replaced direct math.isfinite(float(amount)) check with try-except block that catches OverflowError and ValueError when converting large integers to float, preventing crashes on malformed bids.
